text:
Hana: Quick poll  lunch break power hour tomorrow? Options: quick barbell complex (30m) in the gym or boulder ladder + mobility (30m) on the small wall. Bring water. :barbell: :climber:

Derek: Barbell for me  focusing on light clean+press complexes. Can someone bring collars?

Ivy: Boulder ladder please  want to work on dynos and footwork. I can bring chalk and a tape measure for distance drills. :chalk:

Rafael: Split vote: warm barbell circuit then 20m boulder cooldown. Low volume. Also FYI my trainer friend can lead a 15m mobility slot if we want.

Hana: React with :barbell: for gym, :climber: for boulder, :handshake: for split. If split wins we do 12:00 barbell -> 12:30 boulder. If single activity we start 12:05.

Derek: :barbell: (and I have collars)
Ivy: :climber: :handshake:
Rafael: :handshake:
wellness-bot: Reminder: Gym keycode shared in #help if you need access. Capacity limits: 8 in the gym, 6 at the wall. (automated)
Hana: Looks like split is winning. Plan: 12:00 quick barbell complex (moderate loads, 25min) in the ground-floor gym, then 12:30 boulder ladder at the small wall. Rafael will coordinate mobility slot. Please sign up if you need to borrow shoes/chalk.

Derek: I can loan 2 pairs of collars and a 10kg plate for warmup.

Ivy: I need size 7 shoes if anyone has spares. Will bring brush + tape.

Rafael: Mobility slot confirmed with Leo (trainer). He suggests hip hinge and scap drills for 10 minutes post-lift. See you all noon. :sparkles:

Hana: Final call  DM me if you want a shoe or gear loan. Otherwise see you at the gym lobby 11:55 for quick warmup.
